english.title: Relevant body fail to prevent facilitation of foreign tax evasion offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were a relevant body while **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) committed a foreign tax evasion facilitation offence, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFENCE..), when acting in the capacity of a person associated with you and
(A)_[you were a body incorporated, or a partnership formed, under the law of any part of the United Kingdom]_
(B)_[you carried on business or part of a business in the United Kingdom]_
(C)_[conduct constituting part of the foreign tax evasion facilitation offence took place in the United Kingdom]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46 of the Criminal Finances Act 2017.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person commits foreign tax evasion facilitation offence
while acting in capacity of person associated with relevant body AND
relevant body is a body incorporated or partnership formed in UK OR
relevant body carries on business or part of business in UK OR
any conduct constituting part of foreign tax evasion offence took place in UK

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) See defence in section 46(3), whereby the relevant body does not commit an offence if it can prove that when the foreign tax evasion facilitation offence was committed, it had in place such prevention procedures as it was reasonable in all the circumstances to expect it to have in place, or, it was not reasonable in all the circumstances to expect it to have any prevention procedures in place.

other.penalty:
England and Wales - Either way

Summary: fine
Indictment: fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
